Gust Buster.name: Gust Buster
Gust Buster.summary: Navigate your way through videogame's most colorful amusement park without the use of the joystick. Keep an eye on the windsocks since they indicate the force and direction of wind gusts that will blow you around the park.

Matt Patrol.name: Matt Patrol
Matt Patrol.summary: Matthew "Matt" Householder programmed this a version of Moon Patrol for the Colecovision in 1984. Unfortunately, it was canceled by Atarisoft when he was about to finish the title screen. His work stayed as it was with a temporary title screen (Selma presents Matt Patrol). In 1996 he sold a copy to a collector and a few years later it leaked on the Internet.
